strings.zh: 水晶『{VAR:0103:0}前辈,你看那边。
strings.en: Crystal: {VAR:0103:0}, look over there.

strings.zh: 米那君『水君跑得真快啊,{NEWLINE}一不小心就跟丢了。
strings.en: Eusine: Suicune is so fast. One{NEWLINE}slip and I lost track of it.

strings.zh: 水晶『那位米那君先生{NEWLINE}好像也在这里寻找水君,{CLEAR}咱们去问问他有什么收获吧。
strings.en: Crystal: Looks like Mr. Eusine is{NEWLINE}searching for Suicune here too. Let’s{CLEAR}go ask him if he’s found anything.

strings.zh: 水晶『你好啊,米那君先生。
strings.en: Crystal: Hello, Mr. Eusine.

strings.zh: 米那君『呀,水晶小姐和{VAR:0103:0}！{NEWLINE}你们也到冰之通路来了？
strings.en: Eusine: Oh, Miss Crystal and {VAR:0103:0}!{NEWLINE}You’ve come to the Ice Path too?

strings.zh: 水晶『我们刚好途经冰之通路,{NEWLINE}并且巧合地发现了{CLEAR}疑似水君来过的痕迹,{CLEAR}然后就在这里遇到了米那君先生。{SCROLL}水晶『您应该是一直在追寻水君吧？{NEWLINE}既然能在这里遇到您,{CLEAR}是不是说水君目前正在冰之通路？
strings.en: Crystal: We were just passing through{NEWLINE}the Ice Path and happened to find{CLEAR}what looked like traces of Suicune.{CLEAR}And then we ran into you here.{SCROLL}Crystal: You’ve been chasing{NEWLINE}Suicune all along, haven’t you? If{CLEAR}we’ve met you here, does that mean{CLEAR}Suicune is in the Ice Path right now?

strings.zh: 米那君『非常正确。{NEWLINE}我在42号路遇到水君后,{CLEAR}就一路追它到这里。{CLEAR}但是这个冰之通路的地形有些复杂,{CLEAR}三拐两绕之后还是把水君跟丢了。
strings.en: Eusine: Exactly right.{NEWLINE}I spotted Suicune on Route 42{CLEAR}and chased it all the way here.{SCROLL}But the Ice Path’s layout is{NEWLINE}rather complicated. After a few{CLEAR}twists and turns, I lost it again.

strings.zh: 水晶『其实我倒觉得{NEWLINE}或许还能在这找到水君。
strings.en: Crystal: Actually, I think we might{NEWLINE}still be able to find Suicune here.

strings.zh: 米那君『哦？怎么找到？
strings.en: Eusine: Oh? How?

strings.zh: 水晶『我在湛蓝市的时候发现,{NEWLINE}凡是水君经过的地方,{CLEAR}地上的泥土会呈现出特殊的湿度。{CLEAR}我就是在上层洞穴发现了这种泥土,{CLEAR}才沿着痕迹一路找到这里来的。{SCROLL}水晶『现在地面上{NEWLINE}特殊泥土的痕迹并没有中断,{CLEAR}我们继续沿着它找下去,{CLEAR}应该会有所收获。
strings.en: Crystal: Back in Cianwood City,{NEWLINE}I noticed that wherever Suicune{CLEAR}passes, the soil on the ground{CLEAR}gets a special kind of dampness.{SCROLL}I found soil like that in the{NEWLINE}cave upstairs and followed{CLEAR}the traces all the way here.{SCROLL}Crystal: The trail of that special soil{NEWLINE}hasn’t broken off yet. If we keep{CLEAR}following it, we should find something.

strings.zh: 米那君『水晶小姐你真是太厉害了。{NEWLINE}我研究了水君的事情这么多年,{CLEAR}却从来没有注意到这种细节。{CLEAR}我现在就按照你说的这个规律找找看,{CLEAR}如果水君还没有离开冰之通路,{CLEAR}或许真能找到它。
strings.en: Eusine: Miss Crystal, you’re{NEWLINE}truly amazing. I’ve studied{CLEAR}Suicune for so many years, yet I{CLEAR}never noticed a detail like that.{SCROLL}I’ll search by following your pattern{NEWLINE}right away. If Suicune hasn’t left the{CLEAR}Ice Path yet, we might really find it.

strings.zh: 水晶『{VAR:0103:0}前辈,{NEWLINE}咱们也跟上去看看吧。
strings.en: Crystal: {VAR:0103:0}, let’s go{NEWLINE}after him and take a look too.

strings.zh: 水晶『从这里的湿泥痕迹看,{NEWLINE}水君应该是向北去了。
strings.en: Crystal: Judging by the damp soil{NEWLINE}here, Suicune must have headed north.

strings.zh: 米那君『没错,确实是向北面延伸的,{NEWLINE}那咱们就继续向北找。
strings.en: Eusine: Right, the trail{NEWLINE}definitely leads north. Then{CLEAR}let’s keep searching northward.

strings.zh: 米那君『啊！水君！真的是水君！{NEWLINE}没想到这么快又跟你见面了！
strings.en: Eusine: Ah! Suicune! It really{NEWLINE}is Suicune! I never thought{CLEAR}we’d meet again so soon!

strings.zh: 水君『Suiiii——cun！
strings.en: Suicune: Suiiii-cune!
strings.notes: qa-lints: unified with identical zh elsewhere (zh_variant)

strings.zh: 米那君『看来这次你不打算狂奔逃走。{NEWLINE}也就是说你想在我们三人之中{CLEAR}选一个人作为你的训练家吗？
strings.en: Eusine: So this time you don’t{NEWLINE}intend to run off. Does that{CLEAR}mean you want to choose one of{CLEAR}the three of us as your Trainer?

strings.zh: 米那君『{VAR:0103:0},水晶小姐,{NEWLINE}虽说这次是咱们三人一起发现的水君,{CLEAR}但能追踪到这里主要还是靠{CLEAR}水晶小姐发现了湿润泥土现象。{CLEAR}所以我提议由水晶小姐{CLEAR}第一个尝试捕捉水君,{CLEAR}如果不成功,{CLEAR}再由我和{VAR:0103:0}尝试。
strings.en: Eusine: {VAR:0103:0}, Miss Crystal,{NEWLINE}the three of us found Suicune{CLEAR}together this time. But we only{CLEAR}tracked it here because Miss{CLEAR}Crystal noticed the damp soil.{SCROLL}So I propose that Miss Crystal{NEWLINE}try to catch Suicune first. If she{CLEAR}fails, {VAR:0103:0} and I will try next.

strings.zh: 水晶『不不不,我只是觉得{NEWLINE}碰碰运气或许能找到水君。{CLEAR}说起有资格成为水君训练家的人,{CLEAR}还是你们两位前辈更合适。
strings.en: Crystal: No, no, no! I just{NEWLINE}thought we might get lucky and{CLEAR}find Suicune. When it comes to who{CLEAR}deserves to be Suicune’s Trainer,{CLEAR}you two are much better suited.

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『我觉得米那君说得对,{NEWLINE}能在这里找到水君{CLEAR}主要还是水晶你的功劳,{CLEAR}还是由你先来收服吧。
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: I think Eusine’s right.{NEWLINE}Finding Suicune here was mostly{CLEAR}your doing, Crystal. You should{CLEAR}be the first to try catching it.

strings.zh: 水晶『啊……这……由我来收服,{NEWLINE}真的合适吗？
strings.en: Crystal: Oh... Um... Is it really{NEWLINE}all right for me to catch it?

strings.zh: 乔伊『比起收服水君,{NEWLINE}你们还是先观察一下{CLEAR}水君身上的伤吧。
strings.en: Joy: Rather than catching{NEWLINE}Suicune, you’d better take{CLEAR}a look at its injuries first.

strings.zh: 米那君『水君受伤了？
strings.en: Eusine: Suicune is hurt?

strings.zh: 水晶『乔伊小姐……？
strings.en: Crystal: Nurse Joy...?

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『会出现在这里么……
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: She shows up{NEWLINE}here, of all places...
strings.notes: zh 会出现在这里么 (player's suspicious aside)

strings.zh: 乔伊『我是烟墨市的乔伊,{NEWLINE}因为感受到冰之通路里{CLEAR}有精灵发出受伤的悲鸣{CLEAR}所以赶了过来。{CLEAR}是你们为了捕捉水君弄伤它的吗？
strings.en: Joy: I’m the Joy from{NEWLINE}Blackthorn City. I sensed a hurt{CLEAR}Pokémon crying out in pain inside{CLEAR}the Ice Path, so I rushed over.{SCROLL}Did you hurt Suicune trying to catch it?

strings.zh: 米那君『可是水君看起来很健康啊……
strings.en: Eusine: But Suicune looks{NEWLINE}perfectly healthy...

strings.zh: 水晶『我们只是沿着{NEWLINE}水君的足迹追踪至此,{CLEAR}并不知道它受伤的事。{CLEAR}如果水君身上有伤的话,{CLEAR}就请乔伊小姐为它治疗吧。
strings.en: Crystal: We only followed Suicune’s{NEWLINE}tracks here. We didn’t know it{CLEAR}was hurt. If Suicune is injured,{CLEAR}please treat it, Nurse Joy.

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『没有把吉利蛋{NEWLINE}放出来带在身边……
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: And she doesn’t{NEWLINE}have a Chansey out with her...

strings.zh: 乔伊『好,我现在布置临时的治疗装置。
strings.en: Joy: All right. I’ll set up a{NEWLINE}temporary treatment device now.
{VAR:0103:0}: That device is...!

strings.zh: 水晶『哇,好神奇啊,{NEWLINE}水君自己就过去接受治疗了。
strings.en: Crystal: Wow, how amazing. Suicune went{NEWLINE}over to get treated all on its own.

strings.zh: 米那君『难道水君身上{NEWLINE}真有什么我没注意到的暗伤？
strings.en: Eusine: Could Suicune really have{NEWLINE}some hidden injury I didn’t notice?

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『不,水晶、米那君,{NEWLINE}这个乔伊是火箭队的人,{CLEAR}她安放的装置不是治疗用的,{CLEAR}而是三圣兽的诱捕装置！
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: No, Crystal, Eusine. This{NEWLINE}Joy is with Team Rocket. The device{CLEAR}she set up isn’t for treatment.{SCROLL}It’s a trap for the{NEWLINE}three legendary beasts!

strings.zh: 水晶『也就是说,{NEWLINE}你就是火箭队基地里的那个乔伊！
strings.en: Crystal: So you’re that Joy{NEWLINE}from the Team Rocket base!

strings.zh: 米那君『我就觉得奇怪嘛,{NEWLINE}看来水君受伤的事都是她编的。
strings.en: Eusine: I thought it was odd.{NEWLINE}So she made up the whole story{CLEAR}about Suicune being hurt.

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『那个诱捕装置{NEWLINE}只要给水君洗脑一段时间后,{CLEAR}水君就会听命于她。{CLEAR}为了不让火箭队得到水君,{CLEAR}必须马上破坏掉那个装置。
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: Once that trap{NEWLINE}has brainwashed Suicune{CLEAR}for a while, it’ll obey her.{SCROLL}To keep Team Rocket from{NEWLINE}getting Suicune, we have to{CLEAR}destroy that device right now.

strings.zh: 米那君『决不能让水君落入火箭队手中！
strings.en: Eusine: We can’t let Suicune{NEWLINE}fall into Team Rocket’s hands!

strings.zh: 水晶『我来牵制住乔伊,{NEWLINE}请前辈们趁机破坏装置救出水君。
strings.en: Crystal: I’ll keep Joy busy.{NEWLINE}You two destroy the device and{CLEAR}rescue Suicune while you can.

strings.zh: 乔伊『哼,你们觉得执行这种任务,{NEWLINE}我会自己一个人来吗？
strings.en: Joy: Hmph. Did you think I’d{NEWLINE}come alone on a mission like this?

strings.zh: 乔伊『都出来吧,给我挡住这三个家伙。
strings.en: Joy: Come on out, everyone.{NEWLINE}Stop these three for me.

strings.zh: 为了伟大的火箭队！
strings.en: For the great Team Rocket!

strings.zh: 为了统治世界的梦想！
strings.en: For our dream of ruling the world!

strings.zh: 为了我的乔伊小姐！
strings.en: For my Miss Joy!

strings.zh: {VAR:FF01:200}你们去死吧！！！{VAR:FF01:100}
联盟冠军实在是太厉害了……
strings.en: The League Champion{NEWLINE}is way too strong...

strings.zh: 这个小丫头也不简单……
strings.en: This little girl’s no pushover either...

strings.zh: 对不起啊乔伊小姐,{NEWLINE}我无法继续战斗了。
strings.en: Sorry, Miss Joy...{NEWLINE}I can’t keep fighting.

strings.zh: 乔伊『没关系,我来为你们回复精灵。
strings.en: Joy: That’s all right.{NEWLINE}I’ll heal your Pokémon.

strings.zh: 哈哈,我的精灵痊愈了！
strings.en: Ha ha! My Pokémon are all better!

strings.zh: 只要有乔伊小姐在,{NEWLINE}我们就是无敌的！
strings.en: As long as we’ve got Miss Joy,{NEWLINE}we’re invincible!
strings.notes: RV048: omission: 小姐 kept

strings.zh: 来开始第二回合较量吧！
strings.en: Let’s start round two!

strings.zh: 米那君『可恶,这样下去就没完了。
strings.en: Eusine: Curses,{NEWLINE}this could go on forever.

strings.zh: 水晶『必须要先打倒乔伊才行。
strings.en: Crystal: We have to beat Joy first.

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『让我来试试{NEWLINE}能不能强行突破过去。{SCROLL}{VAR:0103:0}『{VAR:0100:1},准备全力出击！
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: Let me see if I{NEWLINE}can force my way through.{SCROLL}{VAR:0103:0}: {VAR:0100:1},{NEWLINE}get ready to go all out!

strings.zh: 是！
strings.en: Right!

strings.zh: 小豪『呵,好多碍事的讨厌鬼,{NEWLINE}你们聚在这想干什……
strings.en: Goh: Heh. What a bunch of annoying{NEWLINE}pests. What are you all doing here...

strings.zh: 小豪『那个是水君！{NEWLINE}哈哈哈,真是得来全不费功夫！
strings.en: Goh: That’s Suicune! Hah hah hah!{NEWLINE}Talk about falling right into my lap!

strings.zh: 乔伊『喂！你干什么！
strings.en: Joy: Hey! What are you doing?!

strings.zh: 小豪『干什么？{NEWLINE}当然是将水君收入囊中了！{SCROLL}小豪『精灵球,Go！
strings.en: Goh: What does it look like? I’m{NEWLINE}bagging Suicune, of course!{SCROLL}Goh: Poké Ball, go!

strings.zh: 小豪『哈哈,我收服水君了！{NEWLINE}我得到第一只传说中的精灵了！{CLEAR}哈哈哈哈！
strings.en: Goh: Ha ha! I caught Suicune! My first{NEWLINE}Legendary Pokémon! Hah hah hah hah!

strings.zh: 乔伊『不可能！{NEWLINE}洗脑中的精灵怎么会被收进球里！
strings.en: Joy: Impossible! How can a Pokémon{NEWLINE}under brainwashing be caught in a Ball?!

strings.zh: 米那君『我辛辛苦苦追寻的水君,{NEWLINE}就这样被一个精灵球{CLEAR}简简单单地拿下了吗！？
strings.en: Eusine: The Suicune I’ve{NEWLINE}searched for so hard... Taken so{CLEAR}easily, with a single Poké Ball?!

strings.zh: 水晶『我也有点无法接受,{NEWLINE}传说中的精灵就这样被……
strings.en: Crystal: I can’t accept it either. A{NEWLINE}Legendary Pokémon, just like that...

strings.zh: 乔伊『给我包围这个黑皮小子,{NEWLINE}不要让它把水君带走！
strings.en: Joy: Surround that tanned brat.{NEWLINE}Don’t let him take Suicune away!

strings.zh: 小豪『想凭这些虾兵蟹将挡住我？{NEWLINE}别忘了我手里可是有传说中的精灵！
strings.en: Goh: You think these small fry{NEWLINE}can stop me? Don’t forget,{CLEAR}I’ve got a Legendary Pokémon!

strings.zh: 小豪『出来吧水君,{NEWLINE}给这些家伙一点颜色看看！
strings.en: Goh: Come on out, Suicune.{NEWLINE}Teach these guys a lesson!

strings.zh: 小豪『哈哈哈,知道厉害了吧！{NEWLINE}只要有了传说中的精灵,{CLEAR}我就是无敌的！
strings.en: Goh: Hah hah hah! Now you know! With{NEWLINE}a Legendary Pokémon, I’m invincible!

strings.zh: 小豪『下一个该轮到你了,乔伊小姐。{NEWLINE}准备好尝尝我的厉害了吗？
strings.en: Goh: You’re next, Miss Joy. Ready{NEWLINE}to get a taste of what I can do?

strings.zh: 乔伊『你的眼神中,{NEWLINE}有跟我们一样的东西……
strings.en: Joy: In your eyes, there’s{NEWLINE}something just like in ours...

strings.zh: 小豪『少在这套近乎,{NEWLINE}我才看不上你们这些火箭队。{CLEAR}上啊水君！
strings.en: Goh: Don’t try to get chummy. I{NEWLINE}wouldn’t be caught dead with you{CLEAR}Team Rocket types. Go, Suicune!

strings.zh: 小豪『你在犹豫什么呢,水君。{NEWLINE}我让你攻击啊！
strings.en: Goh: What are you hesitating for,{NEWLINE}Suicune? I told you to attack!

strings.zh: 小豪『这到底是怎么回事,{NEWLINE}你为什么不听我的命令！
strings.en: Goh: What’s going on?{NEWLINE}Why won’t you obey me?!

strings.zh: 乔伊『嗯哼哼哼,{NEWLINE}看来洗脑装置的作用还在,{CLEAR}你没有真正收服水君！
strings.en: Joy: Mm-hm-hm-hm. Looks like the{NEWLINE}brainwashing device is still working.{CLEAR}You haven’t really caught Suicune!

strings.zh: 小豪『什么？洗脑装置？
strings.en: Goh: What? Brainwashing device?

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『水晶,米那君,你们听到了吗？{NEWLINE}洗脑装置的作用还在,{CLEAR}小豪也没有真正收服水君。{CLEAR}现在破坏装置的话{CLEAR}或许能还水君自由。{SCROLL}{VAR:0103:0}『米那君你去挡住小豪,{NEWLINE}我来挡住乔伊,{CLEAR}水晶你去破坏装置。{CLEAR}咱们合力救出水君！
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: Crystal, Eusine, did{NEWLINE}you hear that? The brainwashing{CLEAR}device is still working, and Goh{CLEAR}hasn’t really caught Suicune.{SCROLL}If we destroy the device now, we{NEWLINE}might be able to set Suicune free.{SCROLL}{VAR:0103:0}: Eusine, you stop Goh. I’ll{NEWLINE}stop Joy. Crystal, you destroy the{CLEAR}device. Let’s rescue Suicune together!

strings.zh: 米那君『就按你说的办。
strings.en: Eusine: We’ll do as you say.

strings.zh: 水晶『没问题！
strings.en: Crystal: Got it!

strings.zh: 乔伊『没关系,我身上带的药足够,{NEWLINE}现在就为你们回复精灵。
strings.en: Joy: No problem. I’ve brought{NEWLINE}plenty of medicine. I’ll heal{CLEAR}your Pokémon right now.

strings.zh: 不行了,还是打不过啊……
strings.en: It’s no good. I still can’t win...

strings.zh: 我也只剩1只能战斗的精灵了……
strings.en: I’ve only got 1 Pokémon{NEWLINE}left that can fight...

strings.zh: 可恶,全部精灵都被催眠了。
strings.en: Dammit, all my Pokémon got put to sleep.

strings.zh: 水君『Suiiii……！{SCROLL}水君摇头晃脑很痛苦的样子。
strings.en: Suicune: Suiiii...!{SCROLL}Suicune is shaking its head in pain.

strings.zh: 小豪『切,碍事的家伙。
strings.en: Goh: Tch. Pests.

strings.zh: 小豪『怎么回事,为什么还是不听命令。
strings.en: Goh: What’s going on?{NEWLINE}Why won’t it obey me?

strings.zh: 乔伊『看来洗脑的时间已经足够了,{NEWLINE}现在即使没有洗脑装置,{CLEAR}水君也会完全听命于我们火箭队。{SCROLL}乔伊『来吧水君,立刻跟我们一起撤退！
strings.en: Joy: Looks like the brainwashing{NEWLINE}has had enough time. Even without{CLEAR}the device, Suicune will obey{CLEAR}us, Team Rocket, completely.{SCROLL}Joy: Come, Suicune.{NEWLINE}Retreat with us at once!

strings.zh: 乔伊『也无法执行我的命令？{NEWLINE}是因为曾经被收服过的缘故吗？
strings.en: Joy: It won’t obey my orders either? Is{NEWLINE}it because it was caught in a Ball once?

strings.zh: 乔伊『你这个负心人{NEWLINE}三番五次来坏我们火箭队的事,{CLEAR}真是讨厌死了。{CLEAR}你现在马上给我消失！

strings.zh: 乔伊『你这个臭女人{NEWLINE}三番五次来坏我们火箭队的事,{CLEAR}真是讨厌死了。{CLEAR}你现在马上给我消失！
strings.en: Joy: You stinking woman, you keep{NEWLINE}ruining Team Rocket’s plans again{CLEAR}and again. I really can’t stand you.{SCROLL}Disappear this instant!

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『不知道是不是赶在了{NEWLINE}彻底洗脑之前……
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: I hope we made it before{NEWLINE}the brainwashing was complete...

strings.zh: 小豪『哈哈哈,由你们替我{NEWLINE}打烂这个洗脑装置也不错。{SCROLL}小豪『好了水君,{NEWLINE}你现在该听我的命令了吧。{CLEAR}给我把这些碍眼的家伙全部解决掉！
strings.en: Goh: Hah hah hah! Nice of you to{NEWLINE}smash that brainwashing device for me.{SCROLL}Goh: OK, Suicune, now you’ll listen to{NEWLINE}me, right? Take out all these eyesores!

strings.zh: 水晶『你们不要再争着{NEWLINE}给水君下达命令了！{SCROLL}水晶『从水君的眼神里,{NEWLINE}我能感受到它非常混乱和痛苦,{CLEAR}这一定是洗脑装置和精灵球{CLEAR}双重作用的结果。{CLEAR}现在最重要的是给水君解除混乱{CLEAR}帮它减轻痛苦！
strings.en: Crystal: Stop fighting over who{NEWLINE}gets to give Suicune orders!{SCROLL}Crystal: I can see in Suicune’s{NEWLINE}eyes that it’s really confused and{CLEAR}in pain. It must be because of the{CLEAR}brainwashing device and the Poké{CLEAR}Ball working on it at the same time.{SCROLL}What matters most now is clearing{NEWLINE}Suicune’s confusion and easing its pain!

strings.zh: 哈哈,我就知道你不会拒绝。{NEWLINE}那咱们现在开始吧！
strings.en: Ha ha, I knew you wouldn’t say{NEWLINE}no. Let’s get started, then!

strings.zh: 水晶『大竹蹦,凝聚全身的能量{NEWLINE}使出芳香疗法,{CLEAR}看能不能帮水君清醒过来！
strings.en: Crystal: Megaree,{NEWLINE}gather all your energy and{CLEAR}use Aromatherapy! See if you can{CLEAR}bring Suicune back to its senses!

strings.zh: 水君『Suiiii——cun！{SCROLL}水君的眼神变得清澈了！
strings.en: Suicune: Suiiii-cun!{SCROLL}Suicune’s eyes have cleared!

strings.zh: 水君『Suiiii——cun！{SCROLL}水君向水晶点了点头。
strings.en: Suicune: Suiiii-cun!{SCROLL}Suicune nodded at Crystal.

strings.zh: 小豪『喂喂喂,我明明抓住了水君,{NEWLINE}它为什么会自己跑掉啊！
strings.en: Goh: Hey, hey, hey! I definitely caught{NEWLINE}Suicune! Why did it run off on its own?!
strings.notes: RV048: addition: 'fair and square' not in zh (D-1660)

strings.zh: 米那君『你还没看明白吗？{NEWLINE}你的精灵球的作用{CLEAR}和洗脑装置的作用{CLEAR}在水君体内互相冲突,{CLEAR}结果就是你们谁也没能控制水君！
strings.en: Eusine: Haven’t you figured it{NEWLINE}out yet? Your Poké Ball and the{CLEAR}brainwashing device were fighting{CLEAR}each other inside Suicune.{SCROLL}In the end, neither of{NEWLINE}you could control it!

strings.zh: 小豪『原来是你们火箭队的{NEWLINE}狗屁洗脑装置在碍事,{CLEAR}我要揍扁你们！
strings.en: Goh: So it was Team Rocket’s{NEWLINE}bullshit brainwashing device getting{CLEAR}in the way. I’m gonna flatten you!

strings.zh: 乔伊『水君都跑了,{NEWLINE}我们可没时间陪你玩。{CLEAR}全体撤退！
strings.en: Joy: Suicune’s gone, so we{NEWLINE}don’t have time to play with{CLEAR}you. Everyone, retreat!

strings.zh: 小豪『你们几个！{NEWLINE}这次就算没有你们,{CLEAR}我也能破坏装置救出水君。{CLEAR}下次我再抓精灵,{CLEAR}你们少跑出来碍事！
strings.en: Goh: You lot! Even without you,{NEWLINE}I could’ve wrecked that device{CLEAR}and freed Suicune myself.{SCROLL}Next time I’m catching a{NEWLINE}Pokémon, stay out of my way!

strings.zh: 米那君『真是既没礼貌、又没风度,{NEWLINE}这样的人怎么配得上水君呢。
strings.en: Eusine: So rude and so{NEWLINE}graceless. How could someone like{CLEAR}that ever be worthy of Suicune?

strings.zh: 米那君『{VAR:0103:0}、水晶小姐,{NEWLINE}感谢你们为保护水君所作的一切。{CLEAR}既然水君已经奔向了未知的远方,{CLEAR}我也要继续踏上寻找它的旅程了,{CLEAR}咱们以后有缘再见！
strings.en: Eusine: {VAR:0103:0}, Miss Crystal,{NEWLINE}thank you for everything{CLEAR}you did to protect Suicune.{SCROLL}Now that Suicune has run off{NEWLINE}to parts unknown, I too must{CLEAR}continue my journey in search{CLEAR}of it. Until we meet again!

strings.zh: 水晶『前辈,看来失去基地{NEWLINE}也没有让火箭队停止行动,{CLEAR}真不知道他们下一步{CLEAR}又会瞄准哪只传说中的精灵。{CLEAR}为了保护这些精灵,{CLEAR}我还需要继续加油。{CLEAR}正好烟墨市已经近在眼前了,{CLEAR}我就先去那里看看啦。
strings.en: Crystal: It looks like losing{NEWLINE}their base didn’t stop Team{CLEAR}Rocket. I wonder which Legendary{CLEAR}Pokémon they’ll go after next.{SCROLL}To protect those Pokémon, I have{NEWLINE}to keep working hard. Blackthorn{CLEAR}City is right up ahead, so I’ll{CLEAR}go take a look there first.

strings.zh: 小豪『这帮家伙没什么本事,{NEWLINE}跑得倒挺快的。{CLEAR}算了,懒得追了。
strings.en: Goh: Those guys are useless, but{NEWLINE}they sure run fast. Forget it. I{CLEAR}can’t be bothered to chase them.

strings.zh: 看你的样子,应该也是来这极寒之地{NEWLINE}追求训练家极致的修行者吧。{CLEAR}你愿意跟同为修行者的我{CLEAR}来一场较量吗？
strings.en: By the look of you, you’re another one{NEWLINE}who came to this frozen land in search{CLEAR}of the ultimate Trainer training.{SCROLL}Would you have a match{NEWLINE}with me, a fellow trainee?

strings.zh: 我认出你来了,{NEWLINE}你是联盟冠军{VAR:0103:0}！{CLEAR}居然在修行时有幸与联盟冠军交手,{CLEAR}我的运气真是太好了。{CLEAR}感谢你让我见识了{CLEAR}让人仰望又无法触及的{CLEAR}训练家最高境界,{CLEAR}与你的这一场对战{CLEAR}胜过自己埋头苦练百倍。{SCROLL}这个小礼物就当做是我对你的报答了,{NEWLINE}请务必收下它。
strings.en: I recognize you now! You’re the League{NEWLINE}Champion, {VAR:0103:0}! What luck to face{CLEAR}the League Champion during my training!{SCROLL}Thank you for showing me the highest{NEWLINE}level a Trainer can reach, one I can{CLEAR}only look up to and never touch.{SCROLL}This one battle with you beats a{NEWLINE}hundred times the training on my own.{SCROLL}Please accept this{NEWLINE}little gift as my thanks.

strings.zh: 虽然我可能穷尽一生{NEWLINE}也无法达到你这样的训练家境界,{CLEAR}但我绝不会放弃对自己的锻炼！
strings.en: I may never reach your level{NEWLINE}as a Trainer, even if I train{CLEAR}my whole life. But I’ll never{CLEAR}give up on pushing myself!

strings.zh: 呜呜呜……大哥哥,我还年轻,{NEWLINE}我不想就这么老死啊！！！呜呜呜……{CLEAR}有没有什么方法救救我啊！
strings.en: *sob sob*... Mister, I’m still{NEWLINE}young! I don’t want to die of{CLEAR}old age like this!!! *sob*...{SCROLL}Isn’t there any way to save me?!
strings.notes: male player (大哥哥)

strings.zh: 呜呜呜……大姐姐,我还年轻,{NEWLINE}我不想就这么老死啊！！！呜呜呜……{CLEAR}有没有什么方法救救我啊！
strings.en: *sob sob*... Miss, I’m still{NEWLINE}young! I don’t want to die of{CLEAR}old age like this!!! *sob*...{SCROLL}Isn’t there any way to save me?!
strings.notes: female player (大姐姐)

strings.zh: 看到那边的白发老头了吗？{NEWLINE}我亲眼看到他在试图穿过{CLEAR}前面这条隧道时,{CLEAR}从一个黄毛小孩变成了一个白发老头！{SCROLL}这条隧道一定是被下了诅咒,{NEWLINE}任何试图穿过它的人{CLEAR}身上的时间都会被无情地夺走。{CLEAR}你如果不想死的话就离隧道远点。
strings.en: See that white-haired old man over{NEWLINE}there? I saw it with my own eyes. When{CLEAR}he tried to go through the tunnel up{CLEAR}ahead, he turned from a young{CLEAR}kid into a white-haired old man!{SCROLL}That tunnel must be cursed.{NEWLINE}It mercilessly steals the time of{CLEAR}anyone who tries to go through it.{SCROLL}If you don’t want to{NEWLINE}die, stay away from it.
strings.notes: RV048: meaning: 黄毛小孩 = young kid, not blond

strings.zh: 我进入冰之通路时,{NEWLINE}有一个老爷爷警告过我{CLEAR}不要进入地底的隧道,否则会被诅咒。{SCROLL}虽然我谨记他的警告没有进入隧道,{NEWLINE}但是我的小山猪却跑进去转了一圈。{CLEAR}等它出来时,整个的神态就很不对劲,{CLEAR}看起来老态龙钟、死气沉沉的。{CLEAR}我记得那个老爷爷曾经说过{CLEAR}服下多利果可以缓解隧道带来的诅咒。{CLEAR}我已经向卡吉镇的精灵中心求助{CLEAR}拜托他们送一些多利果过来,{CLEAR}不知道什么时候能送到啊。
strings.en: When I came into the Ice Path, an{NEWLINE}old man warned me not to go into the{CLEAR}tunnel down below, or I’d be cursed.{SCROLL}I heeded his warning and stayed{NEWLINE}out of the tunnel, but my Swinub{CLEAR}ran in and took a lap around.{SCROLL}When it came out, it wasn’t itself at{NEWLINE}all. It looked old, frail and lifeless.{SCROLL}I remember the old man saying{NEWLINE}that eating Durin Berries{CLEAR}can ease the tunnel’s curse.{SCROLL}I asked the Pokémon Center in Mahogany{NEWLINE}Town to send some Durin Berries{CLEAR}over. I wonder when they’ll get here.

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『正好我这里有一些多利果,{NEWLINE}你看看能派上用场吗？
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: As it happens, I have some{NEWLINE}Durin Berries. See if they’ll help?

strings.zh: 你身上带着多利果？{NEWLINE}让我看看啊……
strings.en: You’ve got Durin Berries{NEWLINE}on you? Let me see...

strings.zh: 真是抱歉,那个老爷爷说要缓解诅咒{NEWLINE}一次至少得服下10个多利果。{CLEAR}你身上带的多利果明显不够,{CLEAR}我还是等卡吉镇精灵中心{CLEAR}送过来的多利果吧。
strings.en: Sorry, the old man said you have{NEWLINE}to eat at least 10 Durin Berries{CLEAR}at a time to ease the curse.{SCROLL}You clearly don’t have enough.{NEWLINE}I’ll wait for the berries from{CLEAR}the Mahogany Pokémon Center.

strings.zh: 太好了,这么多多利果{NEWLINE}可以帮小山猪挺好一阵子了。{CLEAR}谢谢你送来的果子,{CLEAR}我现在就喂小山猪吃下它们。
strings.en: Great! This many Durin Berries{NEWLINE}will keep Swinub going for a good{CLEAR}while. Thanks for bringing them.{CLEAR}I’ll feed them to Swinub right now.

strings.zh: 来吧小山猪,吃下这些多利果,{NEWLINE}身体的老化可能就会慢一点了。
strings.en: Come on, Swinub, eat these{NEWLINE}Durin Berries. Maybe your{CLEAR}body will age a little slower.

strings.zh: 小山猪『Swiii……
strings.en: Swinub: Swiii...

strings.zh: 看来那位老爷爷说的没错,{NEWLINE}小山猪吃下多利果后似乎是舒服点了。
strings.en: Looks like the old man was right.{NEWLINE}Swinub seems a little more comfortable{CLEAR}after eating the Durin Berries.

strings.zh: 多亏你帮忙,{NEWLINE}小山猪才暂时停止了老去的迹象。{CLEAR}这个是我报答你救命之恩的谢礼,{CLEAR}请收下吧。
strings.en: Thanks to your help, Swinub has{NEWLINE}stopped aging for now. This is my thanks{CLEAR}for saving its life. Please take it.

strings.zh: 如果你想知道更多{NEWLINE}关于这个被诅咒的隧道的事,{CLEAR}可以在冰之通路里找找那位老爷爷。{CLEAR}他似乎对这方面非常有研究。
strings.en: If you want to know more about{NEWLINE}the cursed tunnel, look for{CLEAR}that old man in the Ice Path.{CLEAR}He seems to know a lot about it.

strings.zh: {VAR:FF01:200}喂喂喂！你等一下！{VAR:FF01:100}
strings.en: {VAR:FF01:200}Hey! Wait up!{VAR:FF01:100}
strings.notes: SIZE-200% shout shortened to fit (zh 喂喂喂！你等一下！)

strings.zh: 古老的精灵雕像。
strings.en: An ancient Pokémon statue.

strings.zh: 雕像和身上的金刚宝珠发生了共鸣！
strings.en: The statue is resonating with{NEWLINE}the Adamant Orb you carry!

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『没关系的,{NEWLINE}我已经从一位老爷爷那里得到了{CLEAR}专门用来对抗隧道诅咒的抗老喷雾,{CLEAR}只要喷在身上就能安全穿过这条隧道,{CLEAR}您不必担心。
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: It’s all right. An old{NEWLINE}man gave me an Anti-Age Spray made{CLEAR}specially to fight the tunnel’s curse.{SCROLL}If I spray it on, I can get through the{NEWLINE}tunnel safely. You don’t need to worry.

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}对自己使用了抗老喷雾。
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0} used the Anti-Age Spray!
strings.notes: zh 对自己使用了 (on self): written as a plain item-use line

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『虽然是一次性的,{NEWLINE}但这样暂时就可以去隧道深处探索了。{CLEAR}请您放心,应该不会有事的。
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: It’s only good for{NEWLINE}one use, but it’ll let me explore{CLEAR}deep in the tunnel for now.{CLEAR}Please don’t worry. I’ll be fine.

strings.zh: 既然你这么有信心,{NEWLINE}那就去试试吧。{CLEAR}如果感觉到不对劲就尽快回来。
strings.en: If you’re that confident, go ahead{NEWLINE}and try. If anything feels wrong,{CLEAR}come back as fast as you can.

strings.zh: 在这个冰之通路的最底层,{NEWLINE}有一个被诅咒的隧道,{CLEAR}任何踏入那里的人{CLEAR}最终都会因为诅咒而迅速老去。{SCROLL}如果你没有任何保护措施的话,{NEWLINE}绝对不要踏足那里。
strings.en: On the lowest level of this{NEWLINE}Ice Path, there’s a cursed tunnel.{CLEAR}Everyone who sets foot in it ends up{CLEAR}aging rapidly because of the curse.{SCROLL}Without some kind of protection,{NEWLINE}never set foot in there.

strings.zh: 你知道该怎么穿过隧道吗
strings.en: How do I get through?

strings.zh: 没事了
strings.en: Never mind

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『我听一位训练家说{NEWLINE}冰之通路里有一位{CLEAR}对底层的隧道很有研究的老爷爷,{CLEAR}想必就是您吧？
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: A Trainer told me{NEWLINE}there’s an old man in the Ice Path{CLEAR}who knows a lot about the tunnel{CLEAR}below. That must be you, right?

strings.zh: 很有研究不敢说,{NEWLINE}只是穷尽了一生都在探索{CLEAR}该怎么穿过那条隧道罢了。
strings.en: I wouldn’t say I know a lot. I’ve{NEWLINE}just spent my whole life trying to{CLEAR}find a way through that tunnel.

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『那请问有什么{NEWLINE}穿过隧道的办法吗？
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: Then is there{NEWLINE}any way to get through it?

strings.zh: 根据我无数次的尝试,{NEWLINE}多利果这种树果里面有种成分{CLEAR}可以抵抗隧道诅咒对身体的伤害。{CLEAR}但天然的多利果有效成分含量太低,{CLEAR}必须要用大量多利果{CLEAR}提取出足够多的有效成分,{CLEAR}然后加上辅助原料{CLEAR}制成抗老化的喷雾喷遍全身,{CLEAR}才能在短时间内保证{CLEAR}不被隧道的老化诅咒影响。
strings.en: After countless attempts,{NEWLINE}I found that the Durin Berry{CLEAR}contains something that protects{CLEAR}the body from the tunnel’s curse.{SCROLL}But natural Durin Berries contain too{NEWLINE}little of it. You need a lot of Durin{CLEAR}Berries to extract enough of it.{SCROLL}Then you add other ingredients{NEWLINE}and make an anti-aging spray{CLEAR}to cover your whole body.{SCROLL}Only then are you safe from{NEWLINE}the tunnel’s aging curse,{CLEAR}and only for a short time.
strings.notes: RV048: meaning: 天然 = natural, not wild (D-1661)

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『您制造成功过这种喷雾吗？
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: Have you ever{NEWLINE}managed to make this spray?

strings.zh: 那当然了,{NEWLINE}我能得出这样的结论,{CLEAR}就是因为曾经用手头的原材料{CLEAR}制作了一小瓶这样的喷雾{CLEAR}成功抵抗了老化诅咒,{CLEAR}并向隧道深处走了一段距离。{CLEAR}但遗憾的是我手头的原料不多,{CLEAR}做出的喷雾不够支撑着走到隧道尽头。{CLEAR}所以在我感到身体开始老化之后,{CLEAR}只能匆匆地按原路返回了。
strings.en: Of course. I only know all this{NEWLINE}because I once made a small bottle{CLEAR}of it from what I had on hand.{SCROLL}It held off the aging curse, and I{NEWLINE}made it some way into the tunnel.{SCROLL}Sadly, I didn’t have many ingredients,{NEWLINE}and the spray wasn’t enough to{CLEAR}reach the end of the tunnel.{SCROLL}So once I felt my body starting to age,{NEWLINE}I had to hurry back the way I came.

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『那如果我给您提供{NEWLINE}足够的原材料,{CLEAR}您可以为我制造这样一瓶{CLEAR}抗老化的喷雾吗？
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: If I bring you enough{NEWLINE}ingredients, could you make a bottle{CLEAR}of that anti-aging spray for me?

strings.zh: 没问题,{NEWLINE}只要你给我10个多利果、{CLEAR}5个神奇糖果、{CLEAR}1把圣灰、{CLEAR}1瓶月见山泉水、{CLEAR}外加1万元加工费。{CLEAR}我就可以制造出足够支撑你{CLEAR}走到隧道最深处的一瓶大号喷雾。
strings.en: No problem. Bring me 10 Durin Berries, 5{NEWLINE}Rare Candies, 1 Sacred Ash and 1 Fresh{CLEAR}Water, plus a $10,000 processing fee.{SCROLL}Then I can make you a big bottle{NEWLINE}of spray, enough to get you{CLEAR}to the very end of the tunnel.
strings.notes: 月见山泉水 = Fresh Water (item glossary); 1万元 = $10,000

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『好的,等我把需要的东西{NEWLINE}准备好了再来找您。
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: All right. I’ll come back{NEWLINE}once I have everything ready.

strings.zh: 制作抵抗冰之通路底层{NEWLINE}隧道老化诅咒的喷雾{CLEAR}需要10个多利果、{CLEAR}5个神奇糖果、{CLEAR}1把圣灰、{CLEAR}1瓶月见山泉水、{CLEAR}外加1万元加工费。{SCROLL}如果你准备好了原料和加工费,{NEWLINE}我随时可以为你制作。
strings.en: A spray against the aging curse in{NEWLINE}the tunnel at the bottom of the Ice{CLEAR}Path needs 10 Durin Berries, 5 Rare{CLEAR}Candies, 1 Sacred Ash and 1 Fresh{CLEAR}Water, plus a $10,000 processing fee.{SCROLL}Once you have the ingredients and the{NEWLINE}fee, I can make it for you anytime.

strings.zh: 请为我做一瓶抗老喷雾
strings.en: Make me an Anti-Age Spray

strings.zh: 你的原材料不够啊,{NEWLINE}这样做不出足量的抗老喷雾,{CLEAR}还是等你把原材料都准备充足了{CLEAR}再来找我吧。
strings.en: You don’t have enough{NEWLINE}ingredients. I can’t make enough{CLEAR}Anti-Age Spray with this. Come{CLEAR}back once you’ve got everything.

strings.zh: 你身上的钱不够,{NEWLINE}白让我给你制造喷雾可不行。
strings.en: You don’t have enough money. I{NEWLINE}can’t make you the spray for free.

strings.zh: 东西和钱都准备好了啊,{NEWLINE}那我现在就为你制作抗老喷雾。
strings.en: You’ve got everything and the{NEWLINE}money? Then I’ll make your{CLEAR}Anti-Age Spray right now.

strings.zh: 好了,抗老喷雾制作完成了,{NEWLINE}你拿好它。
strings.en: There, your Anti-Age Spray is{NEWLINE}ready. Take good care of it.

strings.zh: 这瓶抗老喷雾只够支撑你{NEWLINE}探索一次底层隧道,{CLEAR}一定要到隧道入口{CLEAR}再打开喷遍全身。{SCROLL}如果你的喷雾用完了,{NEWLINE}随时可以来找我,{CLEAR}只要有原材料和加工费,{CLEAR}多少瓶喷雾我都可以给你做。
strings.en: This bottle of Anti-Age Spray is only{NEWLINE}enough for one trip into the tunnel{CLEAR}below. Don’t open it and spray yourself{CLEAR}until you’re at the tunnel entrance.{SCROLL}If you run out, come see me{NEWLINE}anytime. As long as you bring the{CLEAR}ingredients and the fee, I’ll make{CLEAR}you as many bottles as you like.

strings.zh: 你身上不是有抗老喷雾吗？{NEWLINE}先把那瓶用完再说吧。
strings.en: Don’t you already have an Anti-Age{NEWLINE}Spray? Use that one up first.

strings.zh: 陷进冰里了,{NEWLINE}没法推……
strings.en: It’s sunk into the ice.{NEWLINE}It can’t be pushed...
strings.notes: US 0123/0 | RV048: omission: ice and push restored

strings.zh: 呜呜呜……{NEWLINE}我终于变回原来的样子了！{SCROLL}年轻真好！
strings.en: *sob sob*... I’m finally{NEWLINE}back to my old self!{SCROLL}It’s great to be young!

strings.zh: 赤日『坂木老大,{NEWLINE}再往前走就会被老化诅咒影响了。{CLEAR}请您使用骑拉帝纳的力量破除诅咒吧。
strings.en: Cyrus: Boss Giovanni, any{NEWLINE}farther and the aging curse will{CLEAR}affect us. Please use Giratina’s{CLEAR}power to break the curse.

strings.zh: 坂木『好。
strings.en: Giovanni: Very well.

strings.zh: 坂木『出来吧骑拉帝纳。
strings.en: Giovanni: Come out, Giratina.

strings.zh: 骑拉帝纳『Giiii——ra！
strings.en: Giratina: Giiii-ra!

strings.zh: 坂木『骑拉帝纳,我们需要穿过这里{NEWLINE}去见你的老朋友帝牙卢卡。{CLEAR}但是这条路受帝牙卢卡力量的影响{CLEAR}时间流逝的速度极端异常。{SCROLL}坂木『现在我要你用力量逆转时间流动,{NEWLINE}帮我们穿过隧道,明白了吗？
strings.en: Giovanni: Giratina, we need to{NEWLINE}pass through here to see your old{CLEAR}friend Dialga. But Dialga’s power{CLEAR}warps this path, and time here{CLEAR}flows at a wildly abnormal speed.{SCROLL}Giovanni: Use your power to{NEWLINE}reverse the flow of time and get us{CLEAR}through the tunnel. Understood?

strings.zh: 哇,我、我、我！我又变回来了！？
strings.en: Whoa, I-I-I...! I’m back to normal?!

strings.zh: 赤日『老大,诅咒……解除了吗？
strings.en: Cyrus: Boss, is the curse... broken?

strings.zh: 坂木『拿精灵试一下就知道了。
strings.en: Giovanni: Test it with a{NEWLINE}Pokémon and we’ll know.

strings.zh: 坂木『骑拉帝纳回来。
strings.en: Giovanni: Giratina, return.

strings.zh: 坂木『出来吧土狼犬。
strings.en: Giovanni: Come out, Poochyena.

strings.zh: 土狼犬『Pooo——chy！
strings.en: Poochyena: Pooo-chy!

strings.zh: 坂木『去,到前面开路,{NEWLINE}带我们穿过隧道。
strings.en: Giovanni: Go. Clear the way ahead{NEWLINE}and lead us through the tunnel.

strings.zh: 喂！我说你们……{SCROLL}就这么过去了！？
strings.en: Hey! Hey, you guys...{SCROLL}You just walked right through?!
strings.notes: RV048: meaning: 我说 is an interjection; he addresses them

strings.zh: 我亲眼看到过一个少年{NEWLINE}在穿过前面这条隧道时,{CLEAR}一下子变成了一个白发老头！{SCROLL}这条隧道一定是被下了诅咒,{NEWLINE}任何试图穿过它的人{CLEAR}身上的时间都会被无情地夺走。{CLEAR}你如果不想死的话就离隧道远点。
strings.en: I saw it with my own eyes: a boy{NEWLINE}went through the tunnel up ahead{CLEAR}and turned into a white-haired{CLEAR}old man in an instant!{SCROLL}That tunnel must be cursed.{NEWLINE}It mercilessly steals the time of{CLEAR}anyone who tries to go through it.{SCROLL}If you don’t want to{NEWLINE}die, stay away from it.

strings.zh: 雕像身上散发着神奇的力量！
strings.en: The statue is giving off{NEWLINE}a mysterious power!

strings.zh: 以前有个少年{NEWLINE}在穿过前面这条隧道时{CLEAR}变成了一个白发老头。{CLEAR}我原本认定这条隧道被下了诅咒,{CLEAR}任何试图穿过它的人{CLEAR}身上的时间都会被无情地夺走。{SCROLL}但我最近好像感觉不到这种诅咒了,{NEWLINE}现在穿过隧道的话应该不会有危险。
strings.en: A boy once went through the{NEWLINE}tunnel up ahead and turned{CLEAR}into a white-haired old man.{SCROLL}I was sure the tunnel was cursed,{NEWLINE}that it mercilessly stole the time of{CLEAR}anyone who tried to go through it.{SCROLL}But lately I can’t seem to feel{NEWLINE}the curse anymore. It should be{CLEAR}safe to go through the tunnel now.
